    Los Fabulosos Cadillacs: Complete Discography
    Music / Latin Rock / Ska | FLAC (16 & 24 bits) | Definitive Collection
    The internationally renowned and versatile Argentine band Los Fabulosos Cadillacs have been thrilling audiences with their eclectic mixture of rock, rap, ska, reggae, and traditional South American sounds since 1985. Run democratically with no single leader, the bandmembers play whatever style most appeals to them at the moment, making each of their albums different from the last.
    From their biggest commercial hits like "Matador" to dream-come-true collaborations with legends like Mick Jones (The Clash) and Debbie Harry on their 1995 album "Rey Azucar", their trajectory is a fundamental pillar of Latin rock. After hiatuses and historic reunions, their legacy remains intact. This super collection brings together their entire musical journey in audiophile FLAC quality (16 and 24 bits), ensuring the ultimate listening experience.

    Editor's Notes

    WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA is the third studio album by American singer Slayyyter. The album is inspired by Slayyyter's upbringing in St. Louis and characters from her adolescence. In comparison to Starfucker and Troubled Paradise, Slayyyter described the album as "more authentically her" and one where she tried revisiting the formative sounds from her teenage years. The album is also inspired by the music she grew up listening to on her iPod, which consisted of a mix of pop, punk, and rap music.
